memberdef.name: type_cast
memberdef.initializer: ({ \ T *r = NULL; \ if (type_assignable(&type_ ## T, (obj->type))) \ r = (T *) obj; \ (r); \ })

briefdescription.para: Determine if the specified object is assignment-compatible with the object represented by type.

memberdef.name: type_foreach_method
memberdef.initializer: for(const struct type_info *_m = (m); _m != NULL; _m = _m->parent) \ for (const struct method_info *method = _m->methods; \ method->name != NULL; method++)
